subject: Kickoff: term elevation + capacity sprint for Brightline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Reed <sophie@brightline.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: term elevation + capacity sprint for Brightline

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Brightline's usage profile shows a steady uplift and the customer success team and I think now is a good time to formalize a short renewal + capacity sprint to align on: term extension options, expected throughput for H2, and an uplift pricing/commit structure.

Proposed objectives for this kickoff:
- Confirm target commit (tokens/month) and timeline for stepped capacity increases
- Align on term length and any contract flex (stair-step vs. flat commit)
- Identify procurement and legal leads and what evidence they need before signature
- Book a QBR to review usage trends and finalize the mutual action plan (MAP)

I've attached the May usage export and a draft term-elevation offer for your review (see attachments). Proposed QBR windows: 2026-06-25 09:00-10:00 PT, 2026-06-29 10:00-11:00 PT, or 2026-07-01 08:00-09:00 PT. Can you confirm which works for your execs and procurement? If none work, please propose two alternate slots.

Action items we can take on immediately if helpful:
- Marissa: pull a short slide deck on top-of-stack usage trends + latency/peak hour graphs
- Rishi: prepare capacity plan and recommended GPU profiles for projected loads
- Neha: prepare 2 discount/commit scenarios and DocuSign-ready terms for quick review

Sophie — could you please confirm the procurement contact (if different from procurement@brightline.io) and any compliance artifacts you need (SOC2, encryption at rest, data retention policy)?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments:
- Brightline_usage_report_May2026.csv (CSV)
- Draft-Term-Elevation-Offer-v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Sophie Reed <sophie@brightline.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement@brightline.io
Date: 2026-06-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: term elevation + capacity sprint for Brightline

Ben — thanks for the clear note and the files. We are definitely interested in locking a stepped commit for H2 to reduce per-token costs as usage grows.

Quick answers: procurement@brightline.io is the correct contact; I'll loop in Ryan (legal) once we have the draft terms. For compliance, we will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and confirmation that data at rest is encrypted and can be routed to our EU region if needed later.

QBR windows: June 29 10:00-11:00 PT or July 1 08:00-09:00 PT look best for our team (June 25 conflicts with an internal offsite). Please tentatively hold June 29 10:00 PT.

A couple of asks ahead of the call: could you surface a 1-slide summary of 90/95/99th latency and a week-over-week token trend for the last 12 weeks? Also please include a short explanation of how fallbacks to lower-cost model variants work during regional capacity pressure.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Reed
Head of Product Ops | Brightline Inc
sophie@brightline.io

Folks — forwarding Sophie's reply. She's tentatively holding June 29 10:00-11:00 PT; procurement@brightline.io is the right procurement contact and they need SOC2 evidence + encryption confirmation.

Please break down tasks below so we can come in prepared and try to have our pre-read slide + pricing scenarios to Sophie by EOD Monday (2026-06-22):
- Marissa: single-slide pre-read with 90/95/99 latency and 12-week token trend, and include a 1-paragraph note on current peak-hour behavior.
- Rishi: capacity profile and recommended GPU mapping for a 3-stage stair-step commit (current, +40%, +100%). Add commentary on how KV-cache/prefix caching will affect effective throughput.
- Neha: two pricing scenarios (stair-step commit and flat commit) with discount ladder and suggested SLA language for latency. Also draft a DocuSign-ready term sheet (use the attached Draft-Term-Elevation-Offer-v1.pdf as the starting point).

I'll tentatively send a calendar hold for June 29 10:00 PT to Sophie and procurement; if any of you can't make that block we should propose the July 1 alternate.

Thanks — let's aim to keep the pre-read tight (1-2 pages).

Ben
